messages:
sam: Deploy bot paused canary for payments: rate_limit_exceeded on chart payments v2.3.0. Auto-retry disabled until rate window. Anyone can triage?

deploy-bot: System: canary pause triggered. Details: reason=rate_limit_exceeded, limit=3 concurrent rollouts per-namespace, current=3, backoff=3m. Actions: no auto-retry, requires manual retry or release consolidation. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/deploy-rate-limit

maria: Thx. Is this the same cluster where 2.3.1 was promoted earlier?

oliver: Yep, eu-west payments had a patch 2.3.1 about 10m ago. It bumped concurrency because it was promoted from a different pipeline.

jen: What's failing in the canary pods? Any logs?

sam: Logs from canary pre-upgrade job:
```
PreUpgradeJob payment-migrations failed: error creating job: pods with same name exist
helm: Upgrade failed: pre-upgrade hook failed
```

dave: "pods with same name exist" usually means a prior job didn't cleanup (failed termination) or hook uses static names. Could be resource name collision between 2.3.0 hooks and the recent 2.3.1.

maria: Option A: pin prod rollout to 2.3.0 and let canary finish after backoff window — minimal blast radius.
Option B: rollforward prod to 2.3.1 but we need to verify migration hook idempotency.

release-manager: Change window ends at 2024-11-05T15:00Z (~40m). Prefer minimal change: pin + hotfix.

oliver: +1 pin. We should dry-run 2.3.1 hooks to confirm naming collisions:
```bash
helm upgrade --install payments payments-chart --version 2.3.1 --dry-run --debug
kubectl get jobs -n payments | grep payment-migrations || true
```

sam: If we pin, deploy-bot needs a manual override to keep canary paused and not retry. How do we record in release notes? Need to note \"pin to 2.3.0 due to concurrent canary preventing safe rollforward\".

deploy-bot: To pin: `/deploy pin payments 2.3.0 --reason \"concurrent canary prevented safe rollforward\" --by sam`

deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged. Existing canary remains paused. Backoff timer retained. manual-unpin required.

dave: I'll open a follow-up for 2.3.2 to make job names unique. ticket INF-1723.

jen: I'll draft release notes and include INF-1723 and the pin rationale.

maria: Quick check — confirm 2.3.1 doesn't already include the job rename? If not, plan for 2.3.2.

oliver: Checked chart repo: 2.3.1 only had image bump + resource limits. No job rename. 2.3.2 needed.

sam: OK pin applied. I'll file the rollback/try log snippet and mark the release as paused in the release spreadsheet.

jen: Thanks. @dave can you own INF-1723 and target a patch before tomorrow morning deploy window? :thumbsup:

dave: Taking it.

maria: Note: we should add console visibility for \"concurrent releases impacting rate limit\" so PMs/SEs aren't surprised. I'll file INF-1724.

sam: Noted. Opening console ticket INF-1724.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks all — closing thread. Will update release notes and follow-ups.
